term: one-atom T/D frame validity and reflexivity/seriality
definition: Valid F quantifies Holds over every atomic valuation and every world. For the Unit atom p, T is box p implies p; D is box p implies diamond p. Reflexive F means every w accesses itself; Serial F means each w has some accessible successor. Empty world types satisfy these universal conditions vacuously. No identity between accessibility and a world-local cause or temporal relation is stipulated. The B axiom uses symmetry alone (KB); standard B additionally includes T (KTB).
note: Mathematical roles of existing Kripke definitions, not source-attributed philosophical commitments or Hilbert completeness. The new proposition is a transparent delivery conjunction only.
